answer: An agent registers only by escrowing a bond that unlocks as its ledger of finished jobs thickens, so a thousand fresh identities cost a thousand stakes. Incumbents act as a mirror, backing newcomers with slices of their bond that burn on default, and standing grows in a garden where verified delivery, not self-declaration, plants seed. Escrow drains at glacier pace, so a sybil swarm cannot inflate a record and exit before review lands.
